note: Acknowledged crates.io drift baseline for the version-drift guard. The guard is GREEN when the registry matches this baseline (or the workspace) and RED only when a NEW divergence appears: a new crate falls behind, or the workspace version is advanced past 'workspace_version' below without publishing (widening the gap). Refreshed 2026-08-18 after the v0.5.24 publish. STANDING DRIFT, and its cause is NOT a credential problem: 19 library crates reached 0.5.24 via the push-to-main lane, while mnemo-mcp-server and mnemo-embeddings-bench are still at 0.5.23 because the tag lane (the only one that publishes them) failed its packaging dry-run: it could not select a version for its mnemo-admin requirement, since mnemo-admin was not in that lane's walk. mnemo-admin is published now, so the walk can resolve on the next run. The earlier note here blamed an expired CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN; that was the #140 diagnosis and it was wrong. See the README Naming section for the per-crate numbers. The 'npm' block guards the TypeScript SDK (sdks/typescript/package.json vs the npm registry) the same baselined way. Refresh after a real publish: bash scripts/check_version_drift.sh --update-baseline
